text:
Maya: heads up 44b vendor integrator (CloudLedger) reported billing break after we rolled new price sheet to cohort X. some invoices show doubled embedding unit rates.
Ethan: is this the cohort X AB split we just enabled? thought cohort X was on legacy until the 15th.
Zoe: confirmed cohort X should be legacy. looks like onboarding script for CloudLedger pulled latest price sheet instead of customer-specific override.
Maya: sample invoice: INV-11200 shows embeddings @0.002/token then again @0.004/token on same line item.
billing-bot: RULE_TRIGGERED: duplicated_rate_detected for INV-11200. link: https://billing.redwood/internal/alerts/1799990000
Ethan: can we temporarily revoke CloudLedger's ingest key and re-run their billing snapshot?
Zoe: yes, revoking now. will schedule a corrected snapshot run for the affected account group. ETA 20m.
Maya: finance approval to auto-credit and notify vendor partner? we have a partner SLA clause.
Ethan: approve up to $2k auto-credit per vendor incident. please tag legal if >$2k.
Maya: noted. drafting partner note, include reconciliation CSV and root cause summary.
Zoe: deploy note to ops runbook: ensure price_sheet_id is fetched from account_override before falling back to default. adding unit test.
Maya: thanks team. will monitor for any other vendor alerts. :ok_hand:
